title: PAWS: NBI finds no animal remains in urns linked to crematorium scam

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) found no traces of animal remains in the urns submitted by complainants in the alleged pet crematorium scam, according to Philippine Animal Welfare Society (PAWS) Executive Director Anna Cabrera. “Instead na na nakita ng kanilang forensics lab ay silicone, iron, potassium and aluminum ang contents nung urn na hindi dapat yung mga elements na yon kung pet remains,” Cabrera told reporters at NBI.
